name: box-centre-not-mass>X
program:
import cadquery as cq

result = (cq.Workplane("XY").polyline([(0, 0), (4, 0), (0, 3)]).close().extrude(1).faces(">X").workplane())
show_object(result)

record.error: ValueError: Selected faces must be co-planar.

name: coplanar-tops>Z
program:
import cadquery as cq

result = (cq.Workplane("XY").box(10, 2, 1).union(cq.Workplane("XY").transformed(offset=cq.Vector(-3, 0, 1)).box(2, 2, 1)).union(cq.Workplane("XY").transformed(offset=cq.Vector(4, 0, 1)).box(1, 2, 1)).faces(">Z").workplane())
show_object(result)

name: half-cylinder>Z
program:
import cadquery as cq

result = (cq.Workplane("YZ").cylinder(4, 1).cut(cq.Workplane("XY").box(10, 10, 10, centered=(True, True, False)).mirror("XY")).faces(">Z").workplane())
show_object(result)

show_object(result)
